newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on moderate enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on moderate enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were offered higher as supplies remained tight amid moderate enquiries from shippers, traders said.
They said 380-cst bunker supplies were offered at about $106/$107 per tonne and 180-cst was offered at around $109-110.
"The enquiries are moderate but the bigger ships for later dates are also being fixed now because the owners are worried that prices will go up again," one supplier said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated around $170 and $180 per tonne respectively.
